name: Lauma
notes: Both sources: EM on sands, goblet and circlet (ER sands as an option), Nightweaver's Looking Glass first. The set differs in order: KQM leads with Silken Moon's Serenade, Game8 lists Deepwood Memories and Silken Moon's Serenade together as best; both stay, Silken Moon first. Goals are Game8's: EM 1,000, CRIT Rate 40-50 (45), CRIT DMG 100+, ER 160-200 (KQM: solo Dendro 170-210 at C0, double Dendro 140-175, with Nefer 210-225; 170 used). Priority: KQM Skill = Burst > character level, Game8 Skill > Burst > Normal Attack. Partners are Dendro and Hydro or Electro teammates (Bloom and Lunar-Bloom teams), from the kit and KQM's 'Nefer teams' rows.
